title: Stem Cell Transplantation (Formerly 110.8.1)
service: Stem cell transplantation (allogeneic HSCT or autologous stem cell transplantation)

criteria.text: Allogeneic HSCT covered for leukemia, leukemia in remission, or aplastic anemia
criteria.span: for the treatment of leukemia, leukemia in remission, or aplastic anemia when it is reasonable and necessary

criteria.text: Allogeneic HSCT for MDS only with IPSS >= 1.5, IPSS-R >= 4.5, or IPSS-M >= 0.5
criteria.span: ≥ 4.5 (high or very high) using the International Prognostic Scoring System - Revised (IPSS-R)

criteria.text: Allogeneic HSCT for multiple myeloma only for Durie-Salmon stage II/III or ISS stage II/III
criteria.span: allogeneic HSCT for multiple myeloma is covered by Medicare only for beneficiaries with Durie-Salmon Stage II or III multiple myeloma, or International Staging System (ISS) Stage II or Stage III multiple myeloma

criteria.text: Allogeneic HSCT for multiple myeloma requires participation in an approved prospective clinical study (CED)
criteria.span: and participating in an approved prospective clinical study that meets the criteria below

criteria.text: Allogeneic HSCT for myelofibrosis only for DIPSSplus Intermediate-2 or High primary/secondary MF in an approved prospective study
criteria.span: allogeneic HSCT for myelofibrosis (MF) is covered by Medicare only for beneficiaries with Dynamic International Prognostic Scoring System (DIPSSplus) Intermediate-2 or High primary or secondary MF and participating in an approved prospective clinical study

criteria.text: AuSCT non-covered for acute leukemia not in remission
Single AuSCT for multiple myeloma only for Durie-Salmon stage II or III
criteria.span: single AuSCT is only covered for Durie-Salmon Stage II or III patients that fit the following requirements

criteria.text: Myeloma newly diagnosed or responsive (>= partial response: 50% decrease in paraprotein or marrow infiltration sustained >= 1 month, or responsive relapse)
criteria.span: Newly diagnosed or responsive multiple myeloma. This includes those patients with previously untreated disease, those with at least a partial response to prior chemotherapy (defined as a 50% decrease either in measurable paraprotein [serum and/or urine] or in bone marrow infiltration, sustained for at least 1 month), and those in responsive relapse

criteria.text: Adequate cardiac, renal, pulmonary, and hepatic function (AuSCT for myeloma)
criteria.span: Adequate cardiac, renal, pulmonary, and hepatic function.

criteria.text: Tandem AuSCT for multiple myeloma non-covered
criteria.span: Tandem transplantation (multiple rounds of AuSCT) for patients with multiple myeloma

criteria.text: HDM/AuSCT for primary AL amyloidosis: amyloid deposition in 2 or fewer organs
criteria.span: Amyloid deposition in 2 or fewer organs

criteria.text: HDM/AuSCT for primary AL amyloidosis: LVEF greater than 45%
criteria.span: Cardiac left ventricular ejection fraction (EF) greater than 45%.

criteria.text: Primary AL amyloidosis covered for any age group (the age >= 64 exclusion ended March 14, 2005)
criteria.span: high dose melphalan (HDM) together with AuSCT is reasonable and necessary for Medicare beneficiaries of any age group with primary amyloid light chain (AL) amyloidosis

criteria.text: AuSCT non-covered for solid tumors other than neuroblastoma

notes: Section D leaves indications not specified as covered or non-covered to MAC discretion, so cases avoid unlisted indications. Low-risk MDS (scores below the thresholds) is not explicitly listed as non-covered and could be read as falling to Section D, so no case tests a below-threshold MDS score. For primary AL amyloidosis the NCD lists criteria (<=2 organs, EF >45%) without an explicit 'only'; case 7 treats failing the EF criterion as not covered (reviewer to confirm). The section g CED study standards are not tested individually; cases state whether the study is CMS-approved.
